---
title: "What changed"
---

Newest first. Anything that moves a date or a deadline is also announced on ETL.

## 2026-09-02 — Week 2 preparation

Week 1 now ends with three things handed to you rather than none: your era team for the Week 2 workshop (drawn at random), the two landmark works your team presents, and the JCEM volume you code in the Week 2 lab. Read both landmark works before Week 2 — the workshop is a prepared presentation, not an in-class reading session.

The eight landmark works are now named on the schedule with full citations, two per era, instead of each team choosing its own.

## 2026-09-02 — Initial publication

First version of the course site. Replaces the PDF syllabus circulated previously.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## How to read this page

Entries record substantive changes only — new readings, moved deadlines, restructured weeks. Typo fixes and formatting are not logged. If you need the exact state of the syllabus on a given date, the full commit history is on GitHub.
:::
